people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Or don’t you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
translations.bsb: Or aren’t you aware that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death?
translations.kjv: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
